issue.title: ref help snapshot still lists clip after the hidden-alias fold (masked by bob-cli-4j)
issue.description:
`cargo test --test cli help::ref_help_matches_grouped_snapshot -- --exact --test-threads=1` fails on master 65501f6 (two serial runs failed the same way on apollo, 2026-10-07). It compares `bob ref -h` with `tests/fixtures/help/ref-short.txt`. Line 11 of that fixture still lists `clip    Capture a web article URL into a Highlights intake PDF`. Commit 84a8a31 ("fold bob ref clip into bob ref create as hidden alias") removed `clip` from the `Highlights pipeline:` group list in `src/native/highlights_ref/cli.rs` but did not update the fixture. f4fb812, which added `jobs`, was the last commit to touch the fixture.

Root cause and fix: delete the stale `clip` line from `tests/fixtures/help/ref-short.txt`, then confirm that no other help fixture or doc still lists `clip` as a visible `bob ref` subcommand. The hidden alias must keep working.

Why no agent saw it: `just all` / `just test` run plain `cargo test`. That stops after the lib test binary fails deterministically on bob-cli-4j, so the `tests/cli` binary never runs. Running `cargo test --no-fail-fast` on 65501f6 gives 3177 passed and 4 failed: bob-cli-4j, this test, `highlights::create::ingest_characterizes_url_failure_modes` (bob-cli-52's landing tale owns that one), and `capture::r#ref::capture_url_with_markers_or_flags_stays_a_task`. That last one passes with `env -u DISPLAY`, so it is an environment issue: the session had an SSH-forwarded DISPLAY with no X server. Run the CLI target explicitly when verifying this fix.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Two exact serial runs (--test-threads=1) on unchanged 65501f6 fail identically: the actual help no longer lists clip, while tests/fixtures/help/ref-short.txt line 11 still does. Commit 84a8a31 removed clip from the group list without updating the fixture.

issue.creation_reason: Found during the 48h task-bead impact audit. Running cargo test with --no-fail-fast showed a deterministic CLI failure on master that has no bead, hidden because the lib failure stops cargo first.
